row.title: Papers are full white papers with a publishing gate
row.body: WHITEPAPER-1 (Rowan 2026-11-25): papers read as white papers, with numbered sections (introduction, background, method, results with a table, discussion, limitations, conclusion) and numbered references cited in the text, assembled from the study file and live measurements. research.gate() holds back a paper missing a section, a citation or a measured result; research --check fails on it. /research is linked from the header, footer, homepage and the family nav tenants read. Tests: test_research 9 pass, site tests 71 pass.
